# Drinking Water Watersheds Influenced by Inventoried Roadless Areas

HUC12 watersheds that supply surface drinking water and are influenced by USDA Forest Service
Inventoried Roadless Areas (IRAs, the areas covered by the 2001 Roadless Area Conservation
Rule), compiled by American Rivers. Here IRA means Inventoried Roadless Area, not the Inflation
Reduction Act.

**9,991 HUC12 watersheds** | Polygon | 37 states (7 records have no state)

Source: American Rivers, ArcGIS item
<https://www.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=6d74d3f1f8d047dd9295467d7671b774>, published with the
2001 roadless areas, national forests and wilderness areas.

## Files

| Format | URL |
|--------|-----|
| GeoParquet | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/ira-watersheds.parquet` |
| PMTiles | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/ira-watersheds.pmtiles` |
| H3 hex (res 8) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/ira-watersheds/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |

**PMTiles source-layer name:** `ira-watersheds`

## Columns

American Rivers publishes no field definitions. Five columns carry the names of USDA Forest
Service Forests to Faucets 2.0 fields
([field definitions](https://data.fs.usda.gov/geodata/edw/edw_resources/meta/Hydro_F2F2_HUC12.xml));
whether American Rivers carried their values over unchanged is not documented.

| Column | Forests to Faucets 2.0 meaning |
|--------|--------------------------------|
| HUC12 | 12-digit Hydrologic Unit Code |
| APCW | Ability to Produce Clean Water (values here run 4 to 64) |
| IMP | Important Areas for Surface Drinking Water, raw value |
| POP_DS | Surface drinking-water population downstream of the HUC12; cannot be summed across watersheds |
| SUM_POP | Surface-water consumers served by intakes in the HUC12 |

`HUC_12_NPR` holds the HUC12 code as text. **BG, BW, FF, MB, SR, IDX**, and the `_NR` and `_SR`
variants of every score, are not defined by either source; their meaning is unknown.

## DuckDB example

```sql
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;
SELECT STATE, COUNT(*) AS watersheds
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-rivers/american-rivers/ira-watersheds.parquet')
GROUP BY STATE ORDER BY watersheds DESC;
```
